name: Pasaka
description: Biblia Takatifu, the Swahili Bible, as a function, with accounts. Send a path or a JSON body; get JSON back.

operations.name: A book
operations.description: One book with every chapter and verse.

operations.name: A verse
operations.description: One verse, by book, chapter and verse number.

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Every verse containing a word or phrase.

operations.name: The whole Bible
operations.description: Every book with every verse. About 5 MB.

operations.name: Register
operations.description: Make an account; the answer carries its api_key. Needs DATABASE_URL in the environment.

operations.name: Login
operations.description: Sign in; the answer carries the account's api_key.

operations.name: Check a key
operations.description: Whether an api_key belongs to someone.

operations.name: A verse, with a key
operations.description: Any Bible request with an api_key is answered only for a valid key.
